# google_apihub_attribute_allowed_values

Manages the allowed values of attributes in the API Hub. This resource can manage allowed values
for both system-defined and user-defined attributes of ENUM type. For system-defined attributes,
immutable values are automatically preserved and cannot be modified or removed.


To get more information about AttributeAllowedValues, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/reference/apis/apihub/rest/v1/projects.locations.attributes)
* How-to Guides
    * [Manage attributes](https://cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/api-hub/manage-attributes)

## Example Usage - Apihub Attribute Allowed Values User Defined


```hcl
resource "google_apihub_attribute_allowed_values" "user_attribute_allowed_values" {
  location     = "us-central1"
  attribute_id = "environment"
  
  # Manage allowed values for a user-defined attribute
  allowed_values {
    id           = "dev"
    display_name = "Development"
    description  = "Development environment"
  }
  
  allowed_values {
    id           = "test"
    display_name = "Testing"
    description  = "Testing environment"
  }
  
  allowed_values {
    id           = "prod"
    display_name = "Production"
    description  = "Production environment"
  }
}
```
## Example Usage - Apihub Attribute Allowed Values System Defined


```hcl
resource "google_apihub_attribute_allowed_values" "system_attribute_allowed_values" {
  location     = "us-central1"
  attribute_id = "system-lifecycle-stage"
  
  # Manage allowed values for the system-defined attribute
  # The resource automatically fetches existing values and preserves immutable ones
  allowed_values {
    id           = "dev"
    display_name = "Development"
    description  = "Development environment"
  }
  
  allowed_values {
    id           = "test"
    display_name = "Testing"
    description  = "Testing environment"
  }
  
  allowed_values {
    id           = "staging"
    display_name = "Staging"
    description  = "Staging environment"
  }
  
  allowed_values {
    id           = "prod"
    display_name = "Production"
    description  = "Production environment"
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `allowed_values` -
  (Required)
  The allowed values for the attribute. This is a list of allowed values
  that can be used for the attribute. For system-defined attributes, some
  values may be immutable and cannot be removed.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_allowed_values).

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the API Hub instance where the system attribute exists.

* `attribute_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the attribute. This can be either a system-defined attribute
  (e.g., "system-lifecycle-stage") or a user-defined attribute.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.



<a name="nested_allowed_values"></a>The `allowed_values` block supports:

* `id` -
  (Required)
  Required. The ID of the allowed value. This should be unique within the
  attribute. If this is an immutable value from the system, it cannot be
  modified or removed.

* `display_name` -
  (Required)
  Required. The display name of the allowed value. This can be updated
  for mutable values.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. The description of the allowed value.

* `immutable` -
  (Optional)
  Output only. Whether the allowed value is immutable. Immutable values
  cannot be modified or removed and will be automatically preserved during updates.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/attributes/{{attribute_id}}`


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


AttributeAllowedValues can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/attributes/{{attribute_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{attribute_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{attribute_id}}`


In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import AttributeAllowedValues using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/attributes/{{attribute_id}}"
  to = google_apihub_attribute_allowed_values.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), AttributeAllowedValues can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_apihub_attribute_allowed_values.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/attributes/{{attribute_id}}
$ terraform import google_apihub_attribute_allowed_values.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{attribute_id}}
$ terraform import google_apihub_attribute_allowed_values.default {{location}}/{{attribute_id}}
```
